CollectionSearchResult.description: is a collection hit plus its owner, and whether the searcher is its owner or a member (open it as their own) or not (open the read-only public view at /u/:owner_username/:id).

DeleteAccountRequest.description: confirms an account deletion: the current password, or for accounts without one (social sign-in) the username typed out.

request_id.description: Quote this when contacting support (also the X-Request-ID header).

FeedCard.description: is one item of the Following feed. Consecutive saves by the same person into the same collection collapse into one card (Count > 1).

Person.description: is a row in followers / following / suggestions lists.

PersonLite.description: is the actor/owner on feed cards.

ProfileHit.description: is a people-search result plus the searcher's relation to them.

QRAuthJoinResponse.description: is what the scanning app gets back from join: its own Centrifugo token for the QR channel (never the browser's).

QRAuthStatus.description: is GET /qr-auth/:id: what the public QR page may know about a sign-in request. Never the token or who's approving it.

RecItem.description: is a For you / trending entry: one link, however many people saved it.

SentInviteResponse.description: is an invite the caller sent, with who it went to.

SocialProfile.description: is GET /profiles/:username: the public profile plus counts and the viewer's relationship to it.

apiKey.description: An API key from Settings → Developers.
apiKey.name: x-api-key

bearer.description: An access token (OAuth, or a first-party session).
